nis2_requirement: Policies on risk analysis and information system security
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: NIS2 asks for an all-hazards approach (cyber + physical + environmental). ISO 27001 already covers this if the risk assessment scope includes physical threats (Annex A theme 7).
action_to_close_gap: Check that the risk assessment explicitly lists physical and environmental hazards for each critical system.

gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Handling itself is covered. The legal reporting duty is a separate obligation (see row M, Art. 23).
action_to_close_gap: Link the incident procedure to the Art. 23 reporting workflow (row M).

nis2_requirement: Business continuity (backup management, disaster recovery) and crisis management
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Backups, ICT continuity and redundancy are covered. Crisis management (crisis cell, decision-making, internal and external crisis communication) is not described in ISO 27001; it sits closer to ISO 22301.
action_to_close_gap: Write a crisis management plan (crisis cell roles + communication plan) and test it once a year with an exercise.

nis2_requirement: Supply chain security, including security of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: ISO 27001 covers supplier policy, contracts, ICT supply chain and monitoring. Art. 21(3) adds more: assess each direct supplier's specific vulnerabilities, the quality of its products and secure development practices, and take into account EU coordinated supply-chain risk assessments (Art. 22).
action_to_close_gap: Add a supplier criticality ranking + a per-supplier security assessment (vulnerabilities and secure development practices); follow EU coordinated risk assessments.

nis2_requirement: Security in acquisition, development and maintenance of network and information systems, including vulnerability handling and disclosure
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Secure development and technical vulnerability management are covered. Coordinated vulnerability disclosure (a public way for outsiders to report vulnerabilities, linked to the national CSIRT under Art. 12) is not required by ISO 27001.
action_to_close_gap: Publish a vulnerability disclosure policy (e.g. a security.txt file and a contact address) and define how reports are handled with CERT-FR.

nis2_requirement: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Monitoring, internal audit and management review cover this directly.
action_to_close_gap: Define a few security KPIs that map to the 10 NIS2 measures and report them in the management review.

nis2_requirement: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Awareness, training and the main hygiene controls (endpoints, malware, patching, configuration) are covered.
action_to_close_gap: Use the ANSSI Guide d'hygiene informatique as a checklist to show the hygiene baseline.

nis2_requirement: Policies and procedures on cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Covered by the cryptography control and legal requirements control.

nis2_requirement: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: HR security, identity and access management, and asset inventory are all covered.

nis2_requirement: Multi-factor or continuous authentication, secured voice/video/text communications, and secured emergency communication systems
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: ISO 27001 asks for secure authentication but does not make MFA mandatory. Secured emergency communication systems are not mentioned.
action_to_close_gap: Make MFA mandatory for remote access and privileged accounts; provide an out-of-band secure channel for crisis communication.

nis2_requirement: Management body approves the risk-management measures, oversees them and can be held liable
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: ISO 27001 requires top management commitment, but not a formal approval of the NIS2 measures nor personal liability of managers.
action_to_close_gap: Get a formal board/management approval of the NIS2 measures and record it.

nis2_requirement: Members of the management body must follow cybersecurity training
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: ISO 27001 competence requirements apply to people whose work affects security; it does not explicitly require training for board members.
action_to_close_gap: Organise and record regular cybersecurity training for the management body.

nis2_requirement: Report significant incidents to the CSIRT/authority: early warning within 24h, notification within 72h, final report within 1 month
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: ISO 27001 has contact with authorities and incident response, but no legal reporting deadlines, content or recipient. This is the biggest gap.
action_to_close_gap: Write a reporting procedure with the 24h / 72h / 1 month deadlines, the ANSSI/CERT-FR contact, a 'significant incident' threshold and report templates.

nis2_requirement: Register with the national authority (ANSSI in France)
gap_what_iso_does_not_cover: Purely legal obligation; nothing in ISO 27001.
action_to_close_gap: Pre-register with ANSSI on messervices.cyber.gouv.fr/nis2 and keep entity data up to date.
